title: Half-Life
shortDescription: A science-fiction action game that uses environmental pacing, authored encounters, and a continuous world to make the player feel inside the experiment.
highlights: Story unfolds through the world instead of constant cutaways
Combat spaces and traversal keep momentum tightly connected

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A foundational PC action selection whose seamless pacing and environmental storytelling still explain why the platform became a home for immersive first-person worlds.
